how.title: How Puzzled works
how.subtitle: One free puzzle a day, plus a full suite when you want to go deeper. Every module follows the same ritual: today's set, one finish, a result you can share.
how.step1Body: One module is free every day and needs no account. Sign in only if you want your streak and stats kept.
how.step2Body: Most puzzles take two to fifteen minutes. Difficulty levels let you warm up or push harder.
how.step3Body: Finish to extend your streak, then send a spoiler-free result card to whoever will race you.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: The short version of how Puzzled works.

free.question: Is Puzzled free?
free.answer: Yes. One puzzle is free every day and never requires payment or an account. Premium adds the full suite, the archive, extra stats and streak freezes.

account.question: Do I need an account to play?
account.answer: No. You can finish today's free puzzle as a guest. An account keeps your streak, results and stats across devices.

schedule.question: When do new puzzles appear?
schedule.answer: Every day at midnight, Hong Kong time. Everyone plays the same set on the same day, which is what makes shared results comparable.

streak.question: How do streaks work?
streak.answer: Finish at least one qualifying puzzle in a product day to extend your streak. A single missed day does not erase your history, and Premium streak freezes can cover a day away.

share.question: Can I share my result without spoiling it?
share.answer: Yes. The result card shows your solving pattern, the module and the day — never the solution. Anyone who opens it plays the same day's puzzle.

catalog.question: Which puzzles are included?
catalog.answer: Nineteen daily modules across words, logic, numbers, spatial play and light entertainment, all following the same daily ritual.
